# SnapGPT

The agentic assistant for the full integration lifecycle, through natural language

[Book a Demo](https://www.snaplogic.com/request-demo)

![SnapGPT processing diagram using natural language and agentic reasoning to manage integrations](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapGPT-Agentic-Assistant-hero-1024x720.webp)

* * *

## SnapGPT translates your business intent into action

Powered by 15+ years of enterprise integration expertise and the leading AI models, SnapGPT understands your environment from day one.

![SnapLogic SnapGPT Product Overview Video](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/SnapLogic-SnapGPT-Product-Overview-Video.webp)

**PLAN**

## Get it right the first time

Plan Mode helps teams clarify requirements and align on business intent before generation begins. It surfaces potential issues early, so you can validate workflow designs and explore approaches upfront, reducing rework and speeding time to production.

![SnapLogic platform showing plan mode in SnapGPT](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapGPT-Tile-Plan.webp)

![SnapLogic platform designer with pipeline and SnapGPT chat window](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapGPT-Tile-Build.webp)

BUILD

## Democratize integration across your team

Describe what you need and SnapGPT handles the complexity, generating and refining integrations with platform intelligence and proven patterns. Write SQL queries, refine mapping expressions, and transform data between formats, no specialist required.

**UNDERSTAND**

## Onboard new users faster and eliminate the expertise gap

SnapGPT analyzes existing pipelines, explains integration logic, and generates documentation for you. It sees what’s on your screen and helps configure integrations, drawing on your organization’s own projects and history to get new team members quickly up to speed.

![SnapLogic platform showing a pipeline in the designer with SnapGPT describing it](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapGPT-Tile-Understand.webp)

![SnapLogic platform Monitor tab showing Active nodes](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SnapGPT-Tile-Operate.webp)

**OPERATE**

## Move from pipeline failure to resolution faster

Monitor Insights brings AI-powered diagnosis and troubleshooting into your operations workflow, helping you investigate pipeline and Snaplex health while surfacing optimization opportunities. The Activity Log adds visibility into AI-assisted activity for administrators.

**Accelerate integrations for Data Engineers**

Data Engineers can easily create workflow and pipeline prototypes, formulate SQL queries, refine mapping expressions, and generate sample data and documentation in natural language to accelerate time to production.

![Accelerate time to production for Data Engineers using SnapGPT](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/use-case-tabs-data-engineers.webp)

**Automate business workflows for RevOps**

RevOps leaders can now quickly generate pipelines to extract Closed won Salesforce opportunities and load them into Snowflake for analytics. SnapGPT can turn this business user intent into integration in minutes.

![Automate business workflows for RevOps using SnapGPT](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/use-case-tabs-revops.webp)

**Bring automation to Human Resources**

Human Resource Managers are able to get the exchange rate for the US Dollar to UK Pound for salary parity and load it into Workday. SnapGPT can bring these suggestions to life, providing instant answers to urgent HR issues. With its ability to handle complex HR data tasks, SnapGPT can assist with getting you the data you need for crafting personalized content for employee engagement and communication.

![Bring automation to Human Resources using SnapGPT](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/use-case-tabs-human-resources.webp)

As an IT Help Desk Manager, you’re always looking for ways to leverage technology to improve speed of issue resolution. With a simple prompt, you have access data from issue tracking systems like Atlassian Jira to measure the speed of issue resolution and how it has changed over time.

## FAQs

What foundation models power SnapGPT?

SnapGPT supports leading foundation models through providers including AWS Bedrock. SnapGPT combines these models with more than 15 years of enterprise integration expertise built into the SnapLogic platform, including platform intelligence, operational context, proven integration patterns, and insights derived from petabytes of integration and automation activity.

How does SnapLogic address customers’ security and privacy concerns?

SnapLogic takes security and privacy seriously. SnapGPT runs within SnapLogic’s managed environment and uses enterprise-grade foundation models hosted through trusted providers. Customer prompts are not used to train the underlying models.

Customers can enable or disable SnapGPT, and administrator controls govern the use of preview data and related AI-powered capabilities

Is SnapGPT generally available?

Yes. SnapGPT is generally available as part of the SnapLogic Agentic Integration Platform. The July 2026 release introduces advanced generation capabilities, Plan Mode, and SnapGPT Activity Log, with SnapGPT Monitor Insights coming soon.

What is SnapLabs?

SnapLabs is a dedicated environment for the SnapLogic community to experience unreleased products and features. SnapLabs provides users early access to cutting-edge solutions and the ability to influence the company’s roadmap by providing valuable feedback on product offerings before they are publicly released. Customers and partners can request access to SnapLabs using [this form](https://www.snaplogic.com/snaplabs).

What is Agentic Integration?

[Agentic Integration](https://www.snaplogic.com/use-cases/agentic-integration) is SnapLogic’s approach to helping enterprises connect applications, data, APIs, and AI systems so AI can move from intent to action. It brings together integration, automation, orchestration, governance, and AI-powered assistance to help teams operationalize AI safely and at scale.

What’s new in the July 2026 release?

The July 2026 release transforms SnapGPT into an agentic assistant for the integration lifecycle. New capabilities include:

- **Plan Mode**, which helps teams clarify requirements, explore implementation approaches, and validate workflows before generation begins.
- **Advanced agentic generation**, including multi-pipeline generation, intelligent pipeline refactoring, reusable expression libraries, and natural-language generation of SnapLogic MCP Servers.
- **Pipeline execution validation**, which verifies portions of the pipeline during generation to surface issues early and produce more complete, accurate, and production-ready integrations.
- **Context-aware generation** through Project Context, allowing SnapGPT to use your organization’s projects and assets to generate more relevant results.
- **SnapGPT Activity Log**, now generally available, providing administrators with visibility into AI-assisted development activity.
- **SnapGPT Monitor Insights**, coming soon, extending AI assistance into production operations with diagnostic intelligence and AI-powered troubleshooting.
